serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Lady Annalie: Heyo! We are here! We can see you, Annalie…{{wi}} There really isn’t a reason to scream, everyone is looking at us now… Lady Annalie: We waited quite a bit for you two! You: What do you mean! We are 5 minutes early! Lady Annalie: Jeez, calm down. This place is not a fast food, act accordingly. You: … This girl… Melissa: I can’t believe you actually fell for that, Anon. She’s just messing with you. Like always. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open Lady Annalie: Come on now, Melissa. Why did you tell him? You spoiled my fun. Melissa: Could you remind me why your friends cancelled this brunch again? I think I forgot. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open Lady Annalie: You don’t remember because I didn’t tell you, but nice try. #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: You and Anon both seem on edge since you found out that you all are just my plan B. Jealousy is not a good look on you, you know? You: It’s more like we are still in shock that you actually have other friends. Lady Annalie: Oh, really? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: And you, {f_botName}, why do you keep smiling like that, huh? Aren’t you bothered like the rest? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Bot: I don’t really care since I’m pretty sure Annalie enjoys hanging out with us the most. #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: There might be some truth to it, but don’t think I would ever admit it! You: Are you done with your teasing, Annalie? Can we order already? Lady Annalie: Fine! But are you really sure it’s such a good idea to rush things? You: What do you mean? Lady Annalie: I’m pretty sure that you three, unlike me, aren’t familiar with this restaurant’s brunch menu. Lady Annalie: I’m sure it wouldn’t be very nice to buy a very expensive dish that you don’t like and be stuck with it! You: I’m sure everything here is pretty good, it’s a fancy restaurant, after all. Lady Annalie: Normally you would be right, but as a sales expert… Come on, Annalie… Your shop is almost always empty, you are no expert! Lady Annalie: You see, this restaurant does something called ‘ingredient management,’ and since the owner is one of these environmentally conscious types, he’s very strict about it. Lady Annalie: Nothing goes to waste here, but how do they manage it? Lady Annalie: Some of the items are in the menu only to get rid of the unused ingredients from other dishes! Lady Annalie: They have attractive prices compared to others, but it’s just a trap! Lady Annalie: For example, the Roasted Vegetable Frittata. It’s made of leftover vegetables from other dishes. Bot: Is it really that bad? Isn’t it a good thing they are trying to be environmentally friendly? Besides, only because vegetables come from other dishes doesn’t mean that it impacts the taste in a negative way, right? They are still fresh. Lady Annalie: You are right. Normally it wouldn’t be a big deal, but this freak of an owner took it to the extreme. He puts everything in there, even vegetables that do not fit into the dish. Proportions of the vegetables can also vary by a lot. Melissa: Wouldn’t it hurt the restaurant's reputation in the long run? Lady Annalie: The menu isn’t very long, but one mediocre dish won’t be a deal breaker for most of the people. Melissa: I guess being stingy does not always pay off. You: Since Annalie’s explanation is over, can we order now? Lady Annalie: I still didn’t tell you about all the tricks here, but I guess it’s fine. What are you going to order? Bot: I will go with Eggs Benedict. Lady Annalie: Good choice, it’s very tasty! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm You: Burrito with scrambled eggs. Lady Annalie: That’s…{{wi}} very much like you. You: What do you mean?! Is there something wrong with it? #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: No, nothing! Lady Annalie: And what will you order, Melissa? Melissa: I’m not really hungry today. #bot.Expression.clear #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open Lady Annalie: Again with this? Come on now, it’s my treat. Not good. Annalie seems to be suspecting something… Melissa: Sorry, but I can’t accept it. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: I know you aren’t saving for a boob job, I was only joking last time, but now I’m getting really concerned about your health. Lady Annalie: Is it some hardcore diet or something? If it is, I’m going to be pissed off! Melissa: It’s nothing like that, don’t worry. Bot: I’m sure Melissa has her reasons, let’s not pry too much into it, ok? Nice one! Good save! Lady Annalie: Huh? But I wanna pry! Thank you, Annalie, for being so nosy. Melissa: Don’t worry, {f_botName}, I don’t mind telling. #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised Melissa: The truth is I have a really bad case of GERD, and it’s very embarrassing for me to eat in public since it makes me burp. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: S-Sorry, Melissa! I didn’t know it was something like that. If I knew, I wouldn’t try to be so forceful about it! Melissa: I know you wouldn’t. Don’t worry, I’m not mad at you. Lady Annalie: It really won’t bother me if you burp like crazy! I promise I will accept you no matter how much you burp! That’s… {{wi}}a little unnecessarily dramatic… #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: Alright, that’s enough. People are staring. Do you want everyone here to know that I burp a lot? #Annalie_Outside.face.smileEyeClosed Lady Annalie: I-I’m shutting my mouth now… #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.normal Melissa: Good. #Cashier.Face.normal #Annalie_Outside.face.normal #bot.Expression.Happy You: I’m starving, let’s call for the waiter already! Lady Annalie: Sure, sure… In the end Melissa managed to fool Annalie, although it seemed for a second that Annalie felt truly bad about forcing her friend to say an embarrassing secret in public. The rest of our brunch was pretty much uneventful. We talked about many things and had a couple of good laughs. Shortly after we finished eating, we decided to end the brunch. It was one of the shorter meetings, but both Annalie and Melissa were working that day, so it couldn’t be helped.
